title: CareOps extraction strategy comparison

rules_only.methodology_note: Real rules-based extractor run locally on the 103-message labeled set. Local latency is measured; cost is zero for the offline rules path.

saved_blind_llm_predictions.methodology_note: Saved structured predictions produced blind to the gold labels, then scored locally. No live API request was made; cost and latency are unknown, not zero.

rules_first_hybrid.methodology_note: Real rules-first routing on the same 103 messages, using saved blind LLM predictions only when rules return Unclear. No live API request was made; cost and latency are unknown.

interpretation: This comparison measures structured message extraction, not end-to-end appointment recovery success.
The saved LLM predictions are not a live API benchmark. Do not claim API cost or latency from this report.
The LLM-only and hybrid results reuse the same saved prediction artifact, so they are not independent replications.
The message set is synthetic and small; validate with domain reviewers and a new locked test set before making broad generalisation claims.
